mapper.select: SELECT * FROM COMMUNITY WHERE 1=1 AND CMTY_DEL = 'N' AND CMTY_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') AND CMTY_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') ORDER BY CMTY_SEQ DESC LIMIT #{listcnt} OFFSET #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY WHERE 1=1 AND CMTY_DEL = 'N' AND CMTY_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') AND CMTY_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')
SELECT * FROM COMMUNITY WHERE CMTY_SEQ= #{cmty_seq} AND CMTY_DEL = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY SET CMTY_COUNT = IFNULL(#{cmty_count}, 0)+1 WHERE CMTY_SEQ = #{cmty_seq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community (cmty_id, cmty_title, cmty_content, cmty_date, cmty_category) VALUES (#{cmty_id}, #{cmty_title}, #{cmty_content}, NOW(), #{cmty_category})
INSERT INTO cmty_comment (cmty_seq, cmty_cmt_id, cmty_cmt_content, cmty_cmt_date) VALUES (#{cmty_seq}, #{cmty_cmt_id}, #{cmty_cmt_content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c1.cmty_cmt_seq, c1.cmty_seq, c1.cmty_cmt_parent_seq, c1.cmty_cmt_id, c1.cmty_cmt_content, c1.cmty_cmt_date FROM cmty_comment c1 WHERE c1.cmty_seq = ${cmty_seq} ORDER BY c1.cmty_cmt_parent_seq, c1.cmty_cmt_seq;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmty_comment (cmty_seq, cmty_cmt_parent_seq , cmty_cmt_id, cmty_cmt_content, cmty_cmt_date) VALUES (#{cmty_seq},#{cmty_cmt_parent_seq} ,#{cmty_cmt_id}, #{cmty_cmt_content}, NOW())
